facts.text: The Argo 30 Guarantee covers tuition and mandatory fees not met by other grants or scholarships for qualifying Pell-eligible Florida residents.

sources.title: Argo 30 Guarantee | University of West Florida

facts.text: UWF's Argo 30 Guarantee covers all tuition and mandatory fees not met by other aid for up to 30 credit hours annually for full-time Pell-eligible Florida undergraduates.

sources.title: Argo 30 Guarantee | University of West Florida
